headline: MBL Infrastructure provides update on arbitration award
hook: Arbitration award update for MBL Infrastructure
summary: MBL Infrastructure Limited has issued a formal update regarding an arbitration award. The company notified the NSE of the development via a press release dated October 6, 2026. This filing follows ongoing legal proceedings related to the company's arbitration matters. Shareholders should review the specific details of the award to understand potential financial implications.
why_it_matters: Arbitration outcomes directly impact company cash flow and balance sheet health.
